auth_posture: scram-sha-256 on every frontend (M9-E1 equalized control)

dataset.policy: per-chunk pgbench -i -s 10, CHECKPOINT + VACUUM (ANALYZE) before each measured block, bloat accounting per chunk

pooler_config:
# pgpool-II M9-E1 equalized control (session-class, pool_hba scram-sha-256)
# refs: runtime-config-connection-pooling.html, runtime-config-connection.html
listen_addresses = '127.0.0.1'
port = 6434
backend_hostname0 = '127.0.0.1'
backend_port0 = 5432
connection_cache = on
max_pool = 1
num_init_children = 100
reserved_connections = 0
listen_backlog_multiplier = 2
serialize_accept = off
child_life_time = 300
child_max_connections = 0
connection_life_time = 0
client_idle_limit = 0
reset_query_list = 'ABORT; DISCARD ALL'
load_balance_mode = off
# auth (docs ch.6 Client Authentication, CI-only): frontend
enable_pool_hba = on
# pool_hba.conf in this workdir carries the scram-sha-256 host entry (6.2.4.2).
# effective backends (children x max_pool) = 100
